Keep in sync with what ships in public/ and src/data/.

entries.name: USDA FoodData Central (food values)
entries.text:
Food values come from the U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service, FoodData Central (Foundation Foods, SR Legacy and FNDDS bulk downloads). FoodData Central data is in the public domain and published under CC0 1.0 Universal.

Thai dish values are estimates made in this app from USDA-based reference recipes; they are not USDA values.

entries.name: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker (lite) model
entries.text: pose_landmarker_lite.task by Google (MediaPipe), served from this app's own files; pose estimation runs on the phone.

entries.name: zxing-cpp (barcode reading, inside zxing-wasm)
entries.text: Barcode reading is done by zxing-cpp, compiled to WebAssembly by zxing-wasm; it runs on the phone.
